Projects

Don Loco Appointment System

A system designed to manage and organize customer appointments for Don Loco.

It helps users schedule appointments, manage booking information, and keep records organized, making the appointment process faster and easier to manage.

Printing Shop Inventory System

A system developed to manage the inventory of a printing shop.

It allows users to record and monitor printing supplies such as ink and bond paper, including their quantity, size, color, and date added. The system helps keep track of available stocks and makes inventory management more organized and efficient.
